newsitem.title: GERMANY: German skier lay for four days near dead wife.
newsitem.headline: German skier lay for four days near dead wife.

text.p: A skier lay near his dead wife on a freezing mountainside in the German Alps for four days after injuring himself in a bid to save her, police said on Thursday.
The 30-year-old man, who was not named, broke his elbow and dislocated his hip when he fell as he was climbing down rocks to reach his wife, 28, who had fallen over a 50-metre cliff.
Police said the couple, from Ravensburg in southwestern Germany, had been equipped for a long-distance ski tour lasting several days.
It was this equipment, including a sleeping bag, which kept the skier alive in sub-zero temperatures until he was discovered by a hunter near the Alpine resort of Oberstdorf.
